signup.heroDesc: Gadzira akaundi yako, pindura mibvunzo yekukumbira yemutyairi, uye isa magwaro ese e-KYC kusanganisira mavhaudha matatu usati wapinda mune iyi purogiramu.
signup.title: Gadzira akaundi & kukumbira
signup.subtitle: Hapana chinofanira kuratidzwa chekero. Isa ID, rezinesi, mufananidzo, uye mavhaudha matatu apfuura.
signup.step1Help: Shandisa zita rako chairo, email inoshanda, nhamba yeWhatsApp, nhamba yako ye-ID/pasipoti/kutiza nyika, uye password ine mavara asingapfuuri 6.
signup.step2Help: Wedzera kero kwaunowanzogara kuitira kuti mapoka erutsigiro, kusimbisa, uye kutsvaga vanokwanisa kusvika panzvimbo yakakodzera.
signup.step3Help: Sarudza bhasikoro, tiudze kuti unoshandisa zvivakwa zvipi zvekuendesa, uye wedzera ruzivo rwekubhadharwa. Kana ukasarudza EFT, nzvimbo dzese dzebhangi dzinodiwa.
signup.weeklyFeeDesc: Mabhasikoro akagadzirira kutyairwa anoratidza mari yawo yevhiki uye nyoreso muruzha.
signup.step4Help: Isa magwaro ese e-KYC iye zvino. Gwaro re-ID, rezinesi rekutyaira, uye mufananidzo zvinogona kuve mafaira ePDF kana mifananidzo. Mavhaudha anogona kuiswa se-PDF kana JPG/JPEG. Kana ukaisa vhaudha reJPG/JPEG, unofanira kunyora mari ye-Rand yemufananidzo iwoyo pachako.
signup.autoDecisionDesc: OnFleet inoverenga mavhaudha matatu apfuura, ichiverengera mari yakabhadharwa, uye ichiverenga mari yeganhuro yevhiki. Pasi peR1000/vhiki = kurambidzwa chinozviita nekuedza zvakare mushure memavhiki maviri. R1000/vhiki kana kupfuura = kubvumidzwa chinozviita.
signup.payslipHelp: Isa PDF kuti riverengwe chinozviita, kana JPG/JPEG wonyora mari ye-Rand pachako.
signup.randAmountHelp: Mavhaudha eJPEG anochengetwa nemari yaunonyora pano.
signup.successToast: Akaundi yagadzirwa uye chikumbiro chizere chatumirwa. Tiri kuongorora magwaro ako iye zvino.
signup.modalDesc: Chikumbiro chako hachikwanise kuenderera mberi kusvikira ruzivo rwunodiwa pazasi rwapedzwa zvakanaka.

fleetApply.availableBikesDesc: Sarudza kubva mumabhasikoro aripo ekuhaya-kusvika-paunova muridzi kuburikidza ne{{fleetName}}. Sarudza bhasikoro raunoda panguva yekukumbira.
fleetApply.clickToSelect: Dzvanya bhasikoro kuti urisarudze mukukumbira kwako. Unogona kuchinja sarudzo yako mudanho re3.
fleetApply.title: Tumira chikumbiro chemutyairi
fleetApply.bikeAvailabilityDesc: Mabhasikoro anongowanikwa kumuridzi weboka iri ndiwo anoratidzwa pano.
fleetApply.step4Help: Isa gwaro re-ID, rezinesi rekutyaira, mufananidzo, uye mavhaudha ako matatu apfuura. Mavhaudha anogona kuve PDF, mufananidzo, gwaro reWord, kana chimwe chinhu chakajairika — kana risiri PDF, uchakumbirwa kunyora mari yemwedzi ye-Rand yakaratidzwa pariri.
fleetApply.autoDecisionDesc: Mavhaudha matatu anodiwa kuti kuverengwe mari yeganhuro yevhiki. Pasi peR1000/vhiki inorambidzwa chinozviita. R1000/vhiki kana kupfuura inoendesa chikumbiro kuongororo.
